thread:
sarah-support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting cost numbers showing $0 or NaN in the Console cost view for some orgs (examples: org_id=6124, org_id=9921). Screenshot: https://files.redwood/mock/snap1.png

mike-analytics: Can you paste a repro? is this on hosted or dedicated customers? any query ids/trace ids?

sarah-support: Hosted. Customer supplied trace id: trace=0a1b2c3d; repro steps from them: 1) Login as account owner 2) Open Console > Usage > Cost by org 3) select last 7 days 4) see $0 / NaN in the per-org column. Happening for ~6 orgs, random. No recent billing changes on their side.

mike-analytics: Thanks. Quick check I ran against raw_events table for the two orgs:
```
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_used) as tokens, SUM(charge_cents) as cents FROM raw_ingest.events WHERE org_id IN (6124,9921) AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-16' GROUP BY org_id;
```
Result: org 6124 -> tokens=0, cents=0 ; org 9921 -> tokens=NULL, cents=4500
Seems like tokens column is NULL or zero for some rows which then flows into the aggregator and frontend calculation -> NaN when dividing cents/tokens.

raj-engineering: That matches a recent change in the ingest pipeline (PR #2314) where we early-exit and drop token_count when a partial event schema is detected. If tokens field is missing we set tokens=NULL in ClickHouse. The cost calculator code doesn't guard for NULL/0.

jen-sre: Any recent deploys? deploy-bot: svc-ingest v1.32.0 deployed 2026-03-15T04:12:08Z to prod (canary -> full).

julia-support: Customers hit us about alerts and billing UI. We should communicate ETA before we backfill.

mike-analytics: Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) quick frontend change to display "—" instead of $0/NaN and avoid division by zero. 2) backend hotfix to coalesce NULL tokens to 0 and guard division to avoid NaN. 3) reprocess affected orgs' raw events to repopulate tokens where possible.

raj-engineering: I'll slice a patch for the backend aggregator now. Patch will: `COALESCE(tokens,0)` in SQL, and set cost_per_token = CASE WHEN tokens=0 THEN NULL ELSE cents/tokens END. Will open PR and request urgent review.

jen-sre: I'll queue a reprocess job for orgs [6124,9921,10112,11003] on the offline reprocessor. Reprocess run id=rp-20260316-45. ETA ~45m. If counts are still missing we will backfill from object storage.

billing-bot: Notifying affected customers: templates/billing_zero_values_v1 queued. Will send once engineering confirms root cause.

mike-analytics: Quick diagnostic query to list orgs with NaN on frontend table:
```
SELECT org_id FROM analytics.cost_aggregates WHERE cost_per_token IS NULL OR cost_per_token = 'NaN' LIMIT 100;
```
Ran it and found 9 orgs. Saving list to /tmp/cost-nans-20260316.csv

sarah-support: Thanks. Can we also add a runbook note for this class of failures? Customers keep asking if money is missing.

raj-engineering: PR opened: github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/2387 - small SQL guard + tests. Will also add logging to trace missing token schemas with count.

deploy-bot: PR #2387 merged to prod-canary at 2026-03-16T13:40:12Z, promoted to prod at 2026-03-16T13:51:30Z.

jen-sre: Reprocess finished rp-20260316-45 at 2026-03-16T14:22:11Z. Confirmed tokens repopulated for orgs 6124/9921. Ran analytics recompute job job-id=agg-20260316-77, finished 2026-03-16T14:55:03Z.

mike-analytics: Frontend patch also deployed (web-console v2.10.3) to avoid showing NaN while backfill runs.

julia-support: Sent initial customer update: "We found an ingest edge-case causing token counts to be omitted; engineering deployed a fix and we are backfilling historical data. You should see corrected numbers within 2 hours."

sarah-support: Closing loop: tickets for affected orgs updated, labels applied: billing-impact, triaged. Thanks all.

raj-engineering: Follow-up action items: add schema validation to ingest pre-checker, add metric `ingest.missing_token_schema.count`, and add an alert if that metric spikes >5/min for >3m. I'll create tickets.
